parameters.query: SELECT status, currency, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COALESCE(SUM(deal_value),0) AS value FROM leads WHERE status NOT IN ('WON','LOST') GROUP BY status, currency ORDER BY status, currency
SELECT currency, COUNT(*) AS won_count, COALESCE(SUM(deal_value),0) AS won_value FROM leads WHERE status = 'WON' AND won_at >= date_trunc('month', now()) GROUP BY currency
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'WON') AS won, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'LOST') AS lost, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status NOT IN ('WON','LOST')) AS active FROM leads
